t: What happens as the good ones go
a: يَذْهَبُ الصَّالِحُونَ الأَوَّلُ فَالأَوَّلُ، وَيَبْقَى حُفَالَةٌ كَحُفَالَةِ الشَّعِيرِ أَوِ التَّمْرِ
p: Yadhhabu-ṣ-ṣāliḥūna-l-awwalu fa-l-awwal, wa yabqā ḥufālatun ka-ḥufālati-sh-shaʿīri awi-t-tamr
m: The righteous depart, the first and then the first, and there remains a residue like the chaff of barley or of dates.
